briefing.headline: xAI and OpenAI push frontier model releases as compute bottlenecks intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a high-velocity phase with multiple frontier labs targeting 2027 deployments. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows in the US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-4 with 2.1T parameters while OpenAI deployed o4-preview internally. Anthropic's Claude 4 shows improved agentic capabilities ahead of public launch.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 800K H200 GPUs this quarter. Microsoft and Google announced new 100MW data center clusters dedicated to training runs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a closed lab or an open-weight coalition by 2028?
